title: Kicked Springy Dongbei Pork Belly Roast
description: A hearty roasted pork belly with a miso-tarragon glaze, perfect for a hangover cure and served on a tagliere for a rustic presentation.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and soak a tagliere in water for easy serving.
In a bowl combine miso paste, soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil, brown sugar, tarragon leaves, garlic, ginger, salt, pepper and water to make a glaze.
Pat the pork belly dry with paper towels and score the skin in a crosshatch pattern.
Brush the glaze all over the pork belly, ensuring the score lines are filled.
Place the pork belly on a rack in a roasting pan and roast for 90 minutes, turning once at 45 minutes.
Baste the pork belly with the remaining glaze every 20 minutes to build a caramelized crust.
When the pork belly is tender and the skin is crisp, remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the pork belly on a tagliere and serve immediately, garnished with additional tarragon leaves if desired.
